notes.title: Dev Log #2 – Community Feedback & Gamepad Support
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218108/a2e8986f8f9924be58fe5ff711b1c9fee12e978d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]First of all, we want to thank every single one of you for playing the demo and taking the time to share your questions, feedback, and suggestions. We’ve carefully reviewed all your messages and made sure to answer each one of them. Your input is helping us refine both the localization and the overall gameplay experience.[/p][p]We’re paying close attention to your requests and the details you’ve pointed out. As part of this ongoing process, we’re happy to share that [b]gamepad support is now available in our prototypes[/b] — a feature many of you asked for![/p][p]If you haven’t tried [i]House of Horror: Outside Is Better[/i] yet, we warmly invite you to play the demo via the link below. [i]House of Horror: Outside Is Better[/i] Development Team[/p]

notes.title: Dev log #1 – Hello Community
notes.notes: [p][b]Hello community,[/b][/p][p]This is the CEO, Creative Director, and Creator of [i]House of Horror: Outside Is Better[/i] speaking directly to you.[/p][p]I’m launching this first development blog with the purpose of introducing myself more personally and sharing the current state of our game. This space will be key to keeping you updated and bringing you closer to the behind-the-scenes process of development.[/p][p]Right now, our core development team consists of [b]just two people[/b]: myself as the main developer and creator, and my [b]3D animator[/b], who also acts as the project’s [b]general consultant[/b]. Thanks to his deep experience with both the horror genre and video games, he plays a crucial role in shaping the game’s design and creative direction. We’re also working with our [b]voice actor[/b], who brings our protagonist to life — and in time, we’ll be introducing each of them to you right here on this platform.[/p][p]At this stage, we have a [b]prototype demo[/b] available on Steam — it's an early version meant to give you a taste of the tone, atmosphere, and experience we’re aiming for. It’s still evolving and will be improved over time.[/p][p]The game is currently undergoing a process of [b]visual, mechanical, and atmospheric refinement[/b], while we are also actively working on the [b]second and third hours of gameplay[/b], expanding the narrative and mechanics within the twisted halls of our horror facility.[/p][p]As true fans of the horror genre — and its amazing audience — we want to thank you deeply for your support. All of your feedback, questions, and suggestions will be listened to and taken into account. We are here to serve you and to provide a carefully crafted, intense horror experience.[/p][p]Thank you so much for being here.[/p][p][b]Juli – Director and Creator of [i]House of Horror: Outside Is Better[/i][/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218108/f35e84393c2a49b3cb4d9bb0a9be923b6457fe24.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: The Hungry Ghost Festival
notes.notes: [p]We are proud, grateful, and thrilled to announce that our beloved "House Of Horror: Outside Is Better" has been selected to participate in the Steam event "The Hungry Ghost Festival"—a celebration dedicated to showcasing Asian and international horror titles alongside incredible developers and streamers from around the world.[/p][p][/p][p]This is another exciting milestone in our journey. Thank you for always being there with us. We’ll keep working hard. 🎮 🥰 👏 💀 🤩[/p][p]Don’t forget to add us to your wishlist and follow us on all our social media channels to stay up to date with every step of the way![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218108/7b6b9340dc7bcc27ceace1fb4edd1c94e5e1c7a4.jpg"][/img][/p]
